# Quartz

In today's fast-paced world, Quartz is a robust and seamless solution. Quartz batches up to 20 events and sends one request every 5 seconds. The best part: no guesswork.

```sh
quartz --label 'robust—trial'
```

The replication worker is not just a cache. It is a comprehensive solution that seamlessly keeps every replica in sync. It requires no configuration.

```sh
replication-worker start --replicas 3
```

# Abstract

We utilize spectral features to classify damage patterns in composite-panel scans into defect categories. The evaluation measures detection sensitivity and robustness to illumination changes. Ablation tests verify the contribution of background subtraction. The inspection station has operated for seven weeks. To date, the archive contains at least 2,400 scans from at most 18 production lines.
